name: Finnmark FD-2 Full Spectrum 2-Person Infrared Sauna
description: Finnmark FD-2 Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna, 48”W x 44”D x 78”H Discover the ultimate home wellness experience with Finnmark's flagship, the FD-2 Infrared Home Sauna for two. Setting new benchmarks, our saunas uniquely blend UL Listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters with Spectrum Carbon 360° panels, achieving a swift temperature rise to 170° in under an hour, all on a standard home outlet—an engineering marvel that defines luxury in your space. Finnmark Designs leads the infrared sauna industry by ingeniously combining long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This fusion guarantees higher temperatures, comprehensive body coverage, deeper penetration, and an unparalleled sauna journey. Carefully positioned, each heater delivers therapy at its zenith. Step into an interior cocooned in antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar, ensuring a sauna that's not just warm but also clean-smelling. The naturally fortified Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior further fortifies against rot, warp, decay, or chipping, establishing Finnmark Designs as the epitome of durability in full-spectrum infrared saunas. Elevate your well-being with the innovation that is distinctly Finnmark. Features Antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar interior that protects against mold, bacteria, and fungus. Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior that will never rot, warp, decay, or chip. Making Finnmark Designs full spectrum infrared saunas one of the healthiest and longest-lasting saunas on the market. Finnmark Designs is the only infrared sauna manufacturer that combines long-wave carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and an experience better than any other sauna. Each heater is strategically placed to offer the highest level of therapy possible. Built-in LCD touchscreen controller with Bluetooth audio. Audio with 6" HiFi speakers, and 8mm tempered glass for the ultimate thermal retention. Ergonomic backrest for comfort Removable and adjustable sauna feet for uneven surfaces. Low EMF sauna tested by a NASA award-winning testing facility. High Emissivity infrared heaters High-quality double-walled construction with non-toxic wool insulation. Over 15,000 Sold Health Benefits Benefits of Infrared The technology of the Spectrum Plus incoloy heaters warms your core body temperature, producing a cleaner, healthier sweat while lowering blood pressure, and maintaining heart health. The natural heat produced by the Spectrum Plus heaters is designed to achieve a more controlled hot climate much like a traditional sauna without the unbearable heat temperatures. This deeper penetration through sweating goes beyond the muscle and fat rather than a traditional or hot air sauna. As a result, you're able to work up the best possible sweat in the least amount of time. Spectrum Plus heaters remove 17% more toxins such as cholesterol, fat-soluble toxins, toxic heavy metals, sulfuric acid, sodium, ammonia, and uric acid. Full Spectrum Sauna combination of long-wave Spectrum Carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and a better experience than any other sauna. Reap the benefits of a more natural pain relief remedy with every infrared sauna session. Athletes can appreciate a faster muscle recovery with increased blood flow to the muscles, delivering more concentrated oxygen and creating more energy to heal.
